definitions.explanation: Someone who visits a home or is invited somewhere. A person being hosted.
Someone who buys goods or services from a business.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{客|きゃく}が{来|き}ます。
この{店|みせ}は{客|きゃく}が{多|おお}いです。
お{客|きゃく}さま、いらっしゃいませ。

notes: Often used with the polite prefix お and suffix さん or さま: お{客|きゃく}さん (customer, polite), お{客|きゃく}さま (customer, very polite). In business contexts, {客|きゃく} alone can sound somewhat blunt.
